name: NORMAL LOW MEADOW FLOOR. Fill almost every pixel ↗ RAISED MEADOW TOP. Fill at least 95 percent of
lower_description: NORMAL LOW MEADOW FLOOR. Fill almost every pixel with exact medium green #43894f (RGB 67,137,79), with only very rare one-pixel darker marks #3f824b. This is flat ground, not a bank or shadow. This exact green must fill the pure lower tile and the lower-ground parts of all transition tiles. Cozy clean 16x16 farming pixel art, very low detail. Fixed straight-on front-facing 2D game view with top seen slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter view.
upper_description: RAISED MEADOW TOP. Fill at least 95 percent of the broad flat top with exact #4a9757 (RGB 74,151,87). This green is subtly LIGHTER than lower #43894f, by about ten percent, but the two surfaces remain very close in hue. A few tiny #509c5d grass strokes only, no dark mottling. Keep the upper and lower fill colours distinct; never fill the top with #43894f. Shallow 3-4 pixel raised grassy bank over muted earth. The outer silhouette is VERY WAVY like a natural pond shoreline: irregular rounded lobes, inward nicks and crooked S-curves; edge pixels wander sideways every 2-4 pixels. Rounded convex and concave corners, no straight block corners. Simple low-detail cozy 16px farm pixel art. Fixed straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front facade, top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter view. No objects, plants, flowers, stones or big grass blades.
transition_description: A low earthy bank with a dark green turf lip, following a crooked, scalloped natural shoreline. Deliberately meandering S-curves, uneven rounded protrusions and small inset bays, like the project pond grass border. Vary the silhouette by 2-4 pixels inside EVERY edge tile so neighboring tiles never form a ruler-straight line. Rounded and irregular convex/concave corners, never 90-degree square corners. Only a narrow dark contact shadow. Keep banks shallow and preserve seamless corner matching.

target_palette.name: Calibrated lawn: lower #43894f, upper #4a9757, subtle green shading and muted earth
